expected_answer_summary: A part-time employee scheduled for 20 hours per week receives 7.5 PTO days.

question: how early for a full week off
expected_answer_summary: A request for three or more consecutive workdays must be submitted at least ten business days in advance.

question: does sick time roll into next year
expected_answer_summary: No. Sick leave does not carry over; unused sick leave expires December 31.

question: new hire can i call out sick right away
expected_answer_summary: Yes. Sick leave is available from day one with no waiting period.

question: when do they ask for a doctors note
expected_answer_summary: Medical documentation may be requested after three consecutive scheduled workdays.

question: how long off for adopting a kid

expected_answer_summary: An eligible employee receives 4 weeks of fully paid foster placement leave.

question: do my benefits stop while im on parental leave
expected_answer_summary: No. Health benefits continue unchanged and employee contributions continue to be deducted.

question: do i need approval before an overnight work trip
expected_answer_summary: Yes. Any overnight trip requires pre-approval.

question: can i book premium economy on a long flight
expected_answer_summary: Premium economy is permitted for flights lasting 6 hours or more.

question: can i expense an uber to the airport
expected_answer_summary: Yes. Airport rideshare or taxi travel is reimbursable without a cap when a receipt is provided.

question: do i need the receipt for a 40 dollar charge
expected_answer_summary: Yes. A receipt is required for any single expense over $25.

question: how many office days for hybrid
expected_answer_summary: Hybrid roles require at least 3 onsite days per week.

question: what hours am i supposed to be reachable
expected_answer_summary: The general core-hours window is 10:00 to 15:00 local time.

question: whats the home internet money each month
expected_answer_summary: The internet allowance is $50 per month.

question: which form changes my bank info
expected_answer_summary: Direct deposit details are changed through the Direct Deposit Authorization Form (BPT-FIN-FRM-205); the payroll policy sets the administration rules.

question: when can i add a new baby to benefits
expected_answer_summary: A qualifying life event allows a benefit election change within 30 days of the event.

question: which health plan gets an hsa
expected_answer_summary: The HSA is available with the Core medical plan only.

question: how many counseling visits are free
expected_answer_summary: The EAP provides 8 free counseling sessions per issue per year.

question: when do i get put in the 401k automatically
expected_answer_summary: Automatic enrollment begins at 3 percent after 60 days unless the employee opts out.

question: how much can i borrow from retirement
expected_answer_summary: One loan is permitted at a time, up to 50 percent of the vested balance and no more than $50,000.

question: when are paychecks supposed to hit
expected_answer_summary: BluePeak pays semi-monthly on the 15th and the last business day of the month.

question: weekend work pay rate for hourly staff
expected_answer_summary: A non-exempt employee receives a 2x premium for weekend and holiday work.

question: how much tuition help is there
expected_answer_summary: The annual tuition allowance is $2,500 for degree or accredited programs.

question: how fast do i report a security incident
expected_answer_summary: A security incident must be reported within 24 hours of discovery.

question: how long is unpaid leave allowed
expected_answer_summary: An unpaid leave of absence is available for up to 12 weeks with People Operations approval.
expected_section: Requesting an Unpaid Leave of Absence

question: having a baby then easing back part time whats the deal
expected_answer_summary: A birth parent receives 16 weeks fully paid; one phased return at a 60 percent schedule is available for up to 4 weeks at full pay. Health benefits continue unchanged during the paid leave.

question: im sick on a hybrid day should i just work from home
expected_answer_summary: Remote work is allowed only when the employee can work safely and productively and the manager approves; otherwise the employee should use the sick-absence process and notify the manager before the shift where possible.
expected_section: 8. Working While Unwell|4. Requesting Medical Leave

question: trip is 3 grand what approvals and when do i get paid back
expected_answer_summary: The trip requires manager and department head approval because it exceeds $2,500; after approval, reimbursement is paid in the next payroll cycle.
expected_section: 6. Manager Approval and Escalation|4. Expense Reimbursement Payment

question: leaving the company what happens to vacation and final check
expected_answer_summary: Accrued unused PTO is paid at base rate in the final paycheck; final pay is issued within five business days of separation or sooner where state law requires.
expected_section: 7. Separation from Employment|7. Separation and Final Pay

question: moving to another state for two months and staying remote
expected_answer_summary: Payroll must be notified when work from another US state exceeds 30 days, and the work arrangement change requires 30 days of notice and manager approval.
expected_section: 7. Working from Another Location|7. Requesting a Change to Your Work Arrangement

question: conference costs 1500 how do i get it approved and book travel
expected_answer_summary: A learning request above $1,000 needs manager and department head approval and may carry a 12-month service commitment; conference travel must be booked under the travel policy.

question: new employee wants health coverage and 401k when can both start
expected_answer_summary: 401(k) eligibility begins on day one; health enrollment must be completed within 30 days of the start date or the employee must wait for open enrollment unless a qualifying event applies.

question: quit notice equipment return and account shutoff timing
expected_answer_summary: The standard resignation notice is two weeks, equipment is due within 30 days of the last working day, and system access is revoked within five business days of separation.
expected_section: Resignation and Notice|Equipment Return|Access on Separation

question: taking parental leave do vacation and sick balances keep growing
expected_answer_summary: PTO accrual continues during paid parental leave, while sick leave accrual does not; the PTO accrual rules are in the PTO policy.
expected_section: 8. Pay and Benefits During Leave|3. Annual Allowance and Accrual

question: need to travel internationally and work there for a bit what approvals
expected_answer_summary: Business travel requires pre-approval when overnight or above $500, while working from another country separately requires advance approval from People Operations, Tax, Legal, and Information Security and is capped at 15 consecutive days.
expected_section: 3. Pre-Approval Requirements|7. Working from Another Location

question: expense report is late from overseas when is cutoff and payment
expected_answer_summary: International expense reports have a 60-day submission deadline; once approved, the reimbursement is paid in the next payroll cycle.

question: adopting and need benefits change plus leave notice
expected_answer_summary: An adoptive parent receives 8 weeks fully paid, should give 30 calendar days of leave notice where foreseeable, and may change benefit elections within 30 days of the qualifying event.

question: how many days do i get for books
expected_answer_summary: Books and learning materials are capped at $75 per request, not measured in days. Distractor note: BPT-HR-PTO-001 contains day-based allowances, but it does not govern books.

question: need 75 back for my gym where does that come from
expected_answer_summary: The wellness program reimburses $75 per quarter for a gym, fitness classes, or equipment. Distractor note: BPT-FIN-EXP-004 also uses $75 for a domestic meal per diem.

question: do i get 30 days to send the baby leave form
expected_answer_summary: Where foreseeable, parental leave notice is due at least 30 calendar days before the expected start date. Distractor note: BPT-FIN-EXP-004 uses 30 days for expense-report submission.

question: my laptop is due back in 30 days does payroll collect it
expected_answer_summary: Company equipment must be returned within 30 days of the last working day. Distractor note: BPT-FIN-PAY-009 is a likely match because the handbook is categorized Payroll, but the rule is in BPT-HR-ONB-012.

question: im sick should i just burn vacation instead
expected_answer_summary: Illness should normally be recorded under Sick Leave rather than PTO. Distractor note: BPT-HR-PTO-001 contains vacation language, but BPT-HR-SICK-002 governs the medical absence.

question: who signs off if i work abroad during a trip
expected_answer_summary: Working from another country requires advance approval from People Operations, Tax, Legal, and Information Security. Distractor note: BPT-FIN-EXP-004 governs travel approval, not permission to work from another country.

question: five days after i leave is that my pay or my login
expected_answer_summary: The five-business-day rule here is system-access revocation. Final pay has a separate five-business-day rule. Distractor note: BPT-FIN-PAY-009 may retrieve on the number collision, but BPT-IT-SEC-011 answers the login question.
expected_section: Access on Separation|7. Separation and Final Pay

question: reimbursement eligibility for an airport uber
expected_answer_summary: Airport rideshare or taxi is reimbursable with a receipt and no cap. Distractor note: BPT-HR-LND-010 has a heading named Reimbursement Eligibility, but the airport expense rule is in BPT-FIN-EXP-004.

question: do unused vacation days roll over or disappear now

question: whats the current max vacation bank 20 or 25
expected_answer_summary: The maximum balance is 25 days; accrual pauses at the cap and resumes when the balance drops.

expected_answer_summary: An Austin hybrid employee follows the site-specific 9:00 a.m.-4:00 p.m. local core window.

expected_answer_summary: Pet insurance is available as a voluntary group-rate program; premiums are employee-paid.

expected_answer_summary: A 30-minute unpaid, duty-free meal period applies to U.S. non-exempt employees.

expected_answer_summary: Standard annual targets are 5 percent of eligible earnings for an individual contributor and 10 percent for a people manager.

expected_answer_summary: Ordinary commuting costs are not reimbursable.

expected_answer_summary: No. BluePeak does not offer a PTO purchase, cash-out, sale, or donation program.

expected_answer_summary: Relocation expenses require a written agreement before the cost is incurred, and may be taxable or repayable.

expected_answer_summary: There is no general cash childcare subsidy; U.S. employees may elect a dependent care FSA.

expected_answer_summary: The EAP benefit and session allowance are stated, but no phone number or provider contact is included.

expected_answer_summary: The provided documents does not describe student loan repayment assistance.
